article.title: 更進新聞：飛豬雙11旅遊促銷，已履約商品成交額按年增60%
article.summary: 新華財經引述飛豬指，雙11活動商品已履約成交總額按年增60%，交易用戶數增41%。
highlights: 促銷主打先購買、其後預約使用的旅遊套票。
數字只涵蓋飛豬平台活動商品及交易用戶。
article.why: 酒店和景點可把售出套票、成功預約及實際使用分開量度。
article.next_step: 按套票批次追蹤購買、預約、核銷及退款，找出最常中斷的一步。
article.detail: 飛豬公布的數字把活動商品已履約成交總額與交易用戶數分開，兩項指標均按年比較。平台促銷以預購後預約的旅遊套票為主。酒店團隊評估同類活動時，可分別追蹤預購、成功預約、實際使用和退款，並檢查熱門日期是否有足夠可預約房量。各批次採用同一觀察期，才便於比較核銷情況。
article.title_en: Update: Fliggy reports 60% growth in fulfilled Singles' Day travel promotion sales
article.summary_en: Xinhua Finance cited Fliggy reporting 60% year-on-year growth in gross merchandise value for fulfilled promotional products, and 41% growth in transacting users.
highlights_en: The promotion focused on prepaid travel packages that customers book later.
The figures cover Fliggy's promotional products and transacting users.
article.why_en: Hotels and attractions can measure package sales, bookings and actual usage separately.
article.next_step_en: Track purchases, bookings, redemptions and refunds by package cohort and identify the largest drop-off.
article.detail_en: Fliggy reported fulfilled promotional gross merchandise value and transacting users as separate year-on-year measures. Its promotion focused on travel packages bought in advance and booked later. Hotel teams evaluating similar offers can track purchases, confirmed bookings, actual usage and refunds separately, and check room availability on popular dates. Use the same observation window across cohorts to compare redemptions.
article.section: 行業影響 & 品牌案例
article.followup: 11月13日版報道雙11主要電商平台估算。飛豬數據早於該期公布，今次補充旅遊套票的履約口徑。
article.followup_en: The November 13 edition covered the overall platform estimate. Fliggy's disclosure preceded that edition and adds a travel-package fulfilment measure.
